Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Book Room ABOUT JM Welcome to JM Marvel Hotel, a perfect blend of comfort and elegance in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. Ideally located just 700 meters from the scenic Hoan Kiem Lake and the bustling Night Market, our hotel offers easy access to the vibrant heart of the city, with the iconic St. Joseph’s Cathedral only 500 meters away. 4-STAR ESTABLISHMENT This brand new building containing 45 Rooms & Suites which are embodies classic and charm designed, romantic style and well-equipped facilities. Many rooms with Large Window, City View, or Balcony will bring customers enjoyable and pleasant staying. YOUR WELL-BEING At JM Marvel Hotel, we offer a rejuvenating spa with expert therapists, a sauna, and a mineral bath for ultimate relaxation. Stay on track with your fitness routine at our fully-equipped fitness center, designed for both comfort and convenience. SERVICE FROM THE HEART At JM Marvel, we deeply value your exploration of Hanoi's cultural gems. Our 24/7 service ensures that you'll always have access to guidance in discovering the city's hidden treasures. With a dedicated team focused on providing exceptional, heartfelt service, we're committed to making your stay with us truly unforgettable.
